sql: SELECT "groupName" FROM "torrents" WHERE "artist" = 'lasean camry' AND ("totalSnatched" = (SELECT MAX("totalSnatched") FROM "torrents" WHERE "artist" = 'lasean camry') OR "totalSnatched" = (SELECT MIN("totalSnatched") FROM "torrents" WHERE "artist" = 'lasean camry'))
SELECT T2."tag" FROM "torrents" AS T1 JOIN "tags" AS T2 ON T1."id" = T2."id" WHERE T1."groupYear" >= 2010 GROUP BY T2."tag" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "groupYear" BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 THEN "totalSnatched" END), SUM(CASE WHEN "groupYear" < 2000 THEN "totalSnatched" END) FROM "torrents"
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT "groupName" FROM "torrents" GROUP BY "groupName" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "releaseType" = 'ep' THEN "totalSnatched" END), SUM(CASE WHEN "releaseType" = 'album' THEN "totalSnatched" END) FROM "torrents"
